declarations.freezeRule: cases.json was written and hashed before this manifest; both files are frozen before the first tested-model run. Do not revise this version after evaluation begins.
declarations.evaluationLimit: Eight internally authored synthetic holdout cases. This is not an external independent evaluation and does not establish general accuracy, legal correctness, nationwide policy coverage, or production reliability.

independence.interfaceMetadataProvidedByParent: Only field enums, salary input key conventions and arithmetic sign convention, and currently covered city/topic metadata; no existing case contents or retrieval/gateway algorithms.
independence.neutralSeededAssistantMessages: Authored fixed context only; not outputs from the tested model.
